name: AST_2_Permitted_Uses_of_Data_Post_Account_Closure
title: AST.2 Permitted Uses of Data Post Account Closure (Function)
description: This category is about what is done with consumers’ data if they close their account (terminate use of the app).

statement.label: AST.2#01
statement.requirement: The system SHALL NOT disclose data associated with a closed account to any new persons or entities, including data that has been de-identified.

statement.label: AST.2#02
statement.requirement: The system SHALL offer the consumer the option to decide what to do with their data, such as keeping it or deleting it.

statement.label: AST.2#03
statement.requirement: IF the system has closed an account THEN the system SHALL NOT use data associated with the closed account for future AI training, fine-tuning, evaluation, or model improvement unless the consumer previously gave specific permission or another applicable legal basis is documented.

statement.label: AST.2#04
statement.requirement: IF consumer data has already been used to train or fine-tune an AI model THEN the system SHOULD explain whether and how the account-closure choice affects already-trained models, derived artifacts, backups, and future model releases, including any technical limits on removing an individual's contribution from a deployed model.
